english: Your scarf is attempting to speak.
I don't like this at all.
Trying to open your mouth, you feel it sluggish and hard.
As if your body is fighting against every inch.
A wriggle is all you get.
There is a powerful force - a pressure - all around you.
The overwhelming weight of societal expectation.
You hear your companion's voice faint. As if he was far, far away.
Stop playing around. Stopping like that reminds me of that time that-
The goblin takes a step closer to you, before jolting back.
It is seeping into every crevice.
You appear to have been enclosed within a Gelatinous Cube.
Everyone knows about these. A Gelatinous Cube.
You are statistically likely to die, here and now.
Not like this, not in this terribly embarrassing way.
What kind of idiot just walks into a Cube?!
Cleric! you hear the goblin's voice faintly behind you. "Listen to me!"
I don't know why, but the Cube ain't aggressive.
He tosses in a rope that quickly gets sucked into the gelatinous mass.
Push a bit closer to the edge, and grab the rope - I'll help pull you out!
The rope doesn't get nearly close enough for you to easily take it, but if you can get to it...
The goblin knows this horror. He does not want you to be dissolved.
No one knows you are here.
You are alone, in the Cube.
You can escape! You're strong enough, right?!
A man is alone. Alone, you can survive.
You struggle against the incredibly hard mass around your limbs.
You press a little further. Again.
Your muscles give out. After reaching just a little bit further.
The burning continues. Inside and around.
Cleric! a faint voice calls out to you.
The one where you're sitting, eyes fixed upon the bucket. The sour apples sticking out of it like a mountain of bad decisions.
That sick and sinking feeling in your stomach.
But you did it. They told you to.
You probably knew it wasn't real. But you did it.
And when you walked up to those kids, at the bottom of that pit behind the Hills Central Lower School, with that bucket filled with fifteen âppleskrutt...
That's when you got that nickname, that stuck around until your dad died, and you left the Hills behind.
They kept saying it. When you got mad they said it. When you played along, mocking yourself. They said it.
It's not even a good name. So uninspired.
Yet you still tried to follow them. To be nice. Play nice. Be a friend.
But eventually they just started running away.
Each time you would try to get close - they would laugh, and snicker, and leave.
AND SO, THE APPLEBOY WAS ALL ALONE, UNTIL THE DAY...
The goblin cannot speak to you... that way.
Show him how a man deals with his problems.
He does not enjoy seeing you be dissolved. Clearly.
What are you sleeping? GET BACK TO THE GRIND!
You push. And fight against the endless pressure of this translucent force of acid and pain.
Let's go! the goblin yells and pulls with all his might.
Your muscles urge to stop. But the lack of pain on each limb as it escapes the Cube's surface causes you to continue.
You pant and wheeze, and cough up pieces of still sizzling Cube ooze onto the dungeon floor.
Part of that is your brain not processing the incredibly horrific burns you've suffered.
Next to you, the goblin laughs. "Holy shit."
I thought you were a goner.
You turn around and look at it.
The massive Gelatinous Cube just... stays. Entirely still.
It does not move, nor react to your presence.
I've seen a few Cubes, but never one that just sits there. Really ominous, honestly.
It's clear that this cube is, at the very least, not actively hostile.
It sort of bounces as you make contact.
The goblin does not have time to finish.
The ooze quickly sends a piece of itself flying towards you, in a tendril-like fashion.
You quickly step out of the way.
You try to step out of the way, but there's no time.
The fist-like formation of its ooze hits you right in the face.
You stumble around in front of the Cube, barely being able to stand.
You took that like a champ. Geez.
But as you get ready for the next attack- it does not come.
You do not seem to do anything to it, beyond causing it to lash out.
Right. It's passive until you start fucking with it.
You reach forward and carefully tap the surface.
But it just burns your hand a bit.
The ooze does not seem to react.
For one, they're never this passive.
They also shouldn't be this big, I don't think. I've heard of them splitting and merging at times, but not to this size.
Beyond that, I just know they're attracted to...
He stops and thinks for a bit. "Uh... what was it..."
It's not clerics, is it? I swear on the gods, if it's clerics...
He lets out a quick laugh.
A well-written book, but... you do not believe Cubes have the ability to read.
He gives you a deep and all-consuming glare.
I'm not talking about the romance novel. Obviously.
The goblin points to the glowing torch, inside the Cube.
I bet that has something to do with it.
